title: Following a customer from the door
target: What a customer in TCG Card Shop Simulator is doing between the door and the counter: it walks a path of its own, wears the bag and the cash the game gives it, and shops to a budget it keeps.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shelf that is stocked enough for a customer to find something

steps.do: Expect a customer to arrive along a path rather than to wander in.
steps.because: a customer follows a path with a seeker and a start-and-end modifier (Customer, m_Seeker, m_OriginalStartEndModifier)

steps.do: Read two customers crossing the shop at different paces as a speed each of them keeps.
steps.because: a customer keeps a move speed, a speed, a waypoint distance, a repath rate and a rotation lerp (m_CurrentMoveSpeed, m_Speed, m_NextWaypointDistance, m_RepathRate, m_RotationLerpSpeed)

steps.do: Look at what a customer is holding, because the bag and the cash are attached to it rather than carried in code.
steps.because: the shopping bag and the customer's cash hang from parent points of their own (m_ShoppingBagTransform, m_ShoppingBagParentTo, m_CustomerCash, m_CustomerCashParentTo)

steps.do: Remember that a customer can be carrying tins and cards at the same time.
steps.because: the items in the bag and the cards in the bag are kept in separate lists (m_ItemInBagList, m_CardInBagList)

steps.do: Expect a winner's goods to be placed rather than dropped.
steps.because: there are prize locations for a big item, an item and a card, each with a swapped version (m_PrizeBigItemLocList, m_PrizeItemLocList, m_PrizeCardLocList)

steps.do: Judge what a customer will spend by the total it is keeping rather than by a mood.
steps.because: a customer keeps a running cost total, a maximum it will spend and the list of items it means to buy (m_CurrentCostTotal, m_MaxMoney, m_TargetBuyItemList)

steps.do: Notice whether a customer is smelly or clean, because each of those has an effect of its own.
steps.because: there are separate effects for being smelly and for being clean (m_SmellyFX, m_CleanFX)

steps.do: Expect a customer to notice you, because it has something to look at you with.
steps.because: a customer carries a collider for being interacted with and a target to look at (m_InteractCollider, m_PlayerLookAtTarget)

commonMistakes: Blocking the path a customer is walking instead of stepping aside.
Assuming a customer's bag holds only cards when it keeps items and cards in separate lists.
Reading a customer's mood as its budget when the budget is a total it keeps.
Forgetting that a customer can be watching you while you work.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
